messages.subject: add title ex post
parts:
Dear all,

I wonder how I can add a title subsequently (or while using lapply) to
my plots if I use lapply with ggplot.

for example:

imgs =
lapply(mydf,"qplot",lag,value,data=r,geom="bar",stat="identity",position="identity")

creates several plots and works just fine. I can call these plots by
imgs[1] and so on.

Now I´d like to add different titles to different plots. Is there a
possibility to add titles to qplots after they have been created ?
Maybe be using a title vector. Or is it even possible to add a
character vector to the lapply function as an additional argument for
qplot ?

thx for any help in advance

best

matt

On Fri, May 21, 2010 at 20:19, ran2 <matthias...@googlemail.com> wrote:
> imgs =
> lapply(mydf,"qplot",lag,value,data=r,geom="bar",stat="identity",position="identity")
>
> creates several  plots and works just fine. I can call these plots by
> imgs[1] and so on.
>
> Now I´d like to add different titles to different plots. Is there a
> possibility to add titles to qplots after they have been created ?
> Maybe be using a title vector.  Or is it even possible to add a
> character vector to the lapply function as an additional argument for
> qplot ?

either you need to have the intended title in mydf and use
+ opts(title=mydf$title)
within the original lapply call, or I think you need to resort to a
for loop afterwards, to be able to track your progress in the look
(have a an index i that you can use to extract the title from a vector
of titles). Performance wise, it should not be too bad to resort to a
loop for such a simple operation.

JiHO
